paper_title: New Developments in the Casimir Effect
notes: Review paper (Bordag, Mohideen, Mostepanenko). Sec.7 derives Yukawa-type non-Newtonian-gravity constraints from Casimir/van-der-Waals force measurements. Headline = strongest, most recent bound: curve 6 in Fig.28 (figCnew.eps), from the gold-coated sphere-disk AFM Casimir measurement (Refs [44]/[306], Eqs 7.16-7.22), which gives the largest strengthening (up to 4500x vs dielectric). Plane = fifth-force |alpha_G| (Yukawa strength relative to Newtonian gravity) vs range lambda; converted to mass via m=1.97e-7 eV*m/lambda. Vector coordinates read from figCnew.eps: x-axis log(lambda/1m) [-9..-4 at px 1300..7676], y-axis log|alpha_G| [0..25 at px 8666..4287]. Curve spans lambda=4.3e-9..1.5e-7 m (m~1.3..49 eV). No statistical CL stated (constraint from |F_hyp|<=Delta_F). Curve 5 (Al AFM, ref [43]) is ~4x weaker; curves 1-4 (Cavendish, dielectric Casimir/vdW, Lamoreaux) cover other lambda ranges and are not traced. Native alpha declaration used (canonical scalar-nucleon g not extractable without modeling test-body composition).
